id: unique identifier for each row.     

country.name: name of the country where the image was taken.                                                                 

country.id: a short code or identifier representing the country.                                                 

region.id: code indicating the region or continent to which the country belongs.                                            

type: the type of data.

imageRelPath: the relative file path to the image within the dataset directory.                                             

topics: string representing one or more topics depicted in the image.   

place: the specific location where the image was taken.

income: household income level associated with the image.
